headword: {人工呼吸器|じんこうこきゅうき}

definitions.explanation: A medical machine that moves air into and out of the lungs of a patient who cannot breathe adequately on their own.

examples.japanese: {人工呼吸器|じんこうこきゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけた。
examples.english: They put him on a ventilator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{人工呼吸器|じんこうこきゅうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: My father still needs a ventilator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人工呼吸器|じんこうこきゅうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなく→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As infections spread, the hospitals ran short of ventilators.

notes:
From {人工呼吸|じんこうこきゅう} (artificial respiration, rescue breathing) + {器|き} (device).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人工呼吸器|じんこうこきゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to put on a ventilator
- {人工呼吸器|じんこうこきゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off a ventilator
- {人工呼吸器|じんこうこきゅうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながれる: to be on a ventilator
